 Concern in Dortmund as Girassy leaves match against Real Betis due to injury
 Thursday 05-11-2026 
 محمد المجدلاوي 
 Borussia Dortmund suffered a blow during their match against Real Betis as their Guinean forward Serhou Guirassy was forced to leave the pitch in the first half due to a physical issue.
 Giraudon went down in the 31st minute of the match, before grabbing his thigh and leaving the pitch to receive treatment.
 Despite returning to the pitch, a discussion between coach Niko Kovač and the medical staff ended with the decision not to risk his continuation, leading to the striker leaving in the 35th minute, with Greek Konstantinos Karitsas coming on in his place.
 Giraši has scored three goals in the Bundesliga and four goals in the UEFA Champions League before this match, making his potential absence a significant blow for the team.
 The nature and severity of the injury remain unclear, and no potential absence duration has been announced, pending a medical assessment by Borussia Dortmund.
